about: Two real redis scale-to-zero outages about 4.5 minutes apart (2026-10-17 22:13 and 22:17), on the kind victim app, after the log-line fix. Live, the repeat still scored 0.41 inconclusive with Remediation x0.35: the scale to zero is stamped to the whole second and ingested 0.66s later, and the Killing warning for the pod it kills carries the same second, so judged at ingestion the new fault looked like a repair of a failure it had just caused. Events and graph captured through the Chronicle API; the four deleted redis pods the live (windowed) graph contained are added to the graph.
